name: zvault-extension
description: ZVault browser extension — encrypted password manager with Nostr sync

scripts.prebuild: wasm-pack build ../../crates/zvault-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../apps/extension/public/wasm --no-typescript && rm -f public/wasm/.gitignore public/wasm/package.json
scripts.prebuild:firefox: wasm-pack build ../../crates/zvault-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../apps/extension/public/wasm --no-typescript && rm -f public/wasm/.gitignore public/wasm/package.json
scripts.predev: wasm-pack build ../../crates/zvault-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../apps/extension/public/wasm --no-typescript --dev && rm -f public/wasm/.gitignore public/wasm/package.json
